_meta.purpose: Hand-written per-site narrative summaries surfaced at the top of the Site / Metering & data quality page. 2-3 sentences in plain English. Refinable by Westbrook ESG team over time without code changes.

ampfield-meadows.summary: BNO site. Sycous sub-meters resident electricity (57 properties) and cold water (57). No gas - fully electric. Limited landlord electricity through Ecotricity. Stark half-hourly data not yet pulled for the two landlord meters.

austin-heath.summary: Bulk-meter site with CHP-driven heat networks. Stark provides half-hourly data for the landlord supply. Sycous sub-meters apartments for electricity and heat across the village. Ecotricity bills 2 gas MPRNs serving the CHP plant.

blendworth-hills.summary: Bulk-meter site with ASHP throughout - fully electric. Stark provides half-hourly data for the landlord supply. Sycous sub-meters 32 properties for heat. Small landlord estate, no gas MPRNs.

bramshott-place.summary: DNO site. No private wire - residents have individual MPANs on their own supplier contracts (invisible to Westbrook). Ecotricity bills the small landlord estate and 3 gas MPRNs. No Sycous coverage. The 191 resident MPANs are derived from arbnco, not measured directly.

durrants-village.summary: DNO site with individual ASHP per unit - no heat network. Small landlord estate billed via Ecotricity, Stark provides HH for the landlord supply. 173 resident electricity meters sit on individual supplier contracts; Westbrook has no visibility on them.

edwalton-office.summary: Office building - not a residential village. No accommodation meter estate. Out of GRESB FY25 scope.

elderswell.summary: DNO site with hybrid heating. Limited landlord electricity through Ecotricity, Stark provides HH for two landlord meters (Electric Room + Plant Room). 1 gas MPRN. No Sycous coverage. 145 planned resident meters sit outside Westbrook's visibility.

gifford-lea.summary: Bulk-meter site with a single CHP heat network. Stark provides half-hourly data for the landlord supply. Sycous sub-meters resident electricity and heat across all phases. Single Ecotricity gas MPRN serves the CHP plant.

great-alne-park.summary: DNO site with individual ASHP per unit. Small landlord supply via Ecotricity, Stark provides HH. The 171 planned resident meters sit outside Westbrook's supply contract.

ledian-gardens.summary: BNO site - Westbrook owns the cable network but residents have individual MPANs on it. Ecotricity bills 4 gas MPRNs and a small landlord estate. Sycous sub-meters 63 properties for heat and 63 for hot water. Approximately 162 resident MPANs sit on Westbrook-owned cable but are invisible to Westbrook.

millbrook-village.summary: Bulk-meter site with mixed heating strategies - pool gas + village-centre ASHP. Stark provides half-hourly data for the landlord supply. Single Ecotricity gas MPRN serves pool and back-of-house only. Sycous sub-metering not currently deployed.

millfield-green.summary: Bulk-meter site, fully electric with individual GSHP per unit. Stark provides half-hourly data for the single landlord MPAN at the head of supply. Sycous sub-meters all 133 apartments behind it for resident billing. No gas, no invisible-to-Westbrook layer.

sonning-common.summary: Bulk-meter site, under construction. GSHP throughout, no gas. Limited current metering - out of GRESB FY25 scope until operational.
